name: What is the role of an interior designer in a luxury custom home project?

mainEntity.name: What is the role of an interior designer in a luxury custom home project?

acceptedAnswer.text: An interior designer plays a crucial role in shaping the aesthetic and functionality of your luxury custom home. They work alongside the architect and builder to select finishes, fixtures, color palettes, and furnishings that align with your vision and lifestyle. Their expertise ensures cohesive design, optimal space utilization, and the integration of sophisticated elements that elevate the home's overall luxury appeal, contributing to a truly bespoke and comfortable living environment.
acceptedAnswer.description: An interior designer selects finishes, fixtures, and furnishings to ensure cohesive design and optimal functionality in your custom home.
